title: Force all twelve complete native preludes to their original line pairs (no new kappa)
body:
PR5096 forces the first positive prelude image line, but explicitly leaves later contacts and the inverse occurrence available for widening. On the exact PR4610 round-three scalar graph, this follow-up proves that all twelve inverse returns are forced too. Each complete prelude must therefore retain its original one-dimensional input/image pair.

The new bound starts at the first scalar contact **after** the inverse. Eight literal paths to fixed main-Y exits give its upper space `<a_j>`. One shared rank-zero transported native map and its inverse then close

`<a_j> <= U_j <= G_j^-1 V_j = W_j <= next contact <= <a_j>`.

This forces both warp ends and all four prelude contacts to be lines. PR5096 supplies the separately credited corollary that the image is exactly `<45>`. The argument releases all helper/owned boundaries and cuts all other warp incidences. It assumes the retained monotone persistent-owner segments, including the boundary segments, and the exact `G(U)`/`G^-1(V)` native-map contract.

Evidence at `1e8187bea856a358ece55fb844189078bfae48b3`:

- 96 paths / 993 actual consecutive-owner links per orientation; independent rank-eight normal and 512-vector kernel checks.
- A separately written checker reconstructs all 52 reachable main-Y exits for each of 24 cases and all 1,986 submitted links, without importing the generator.
- Six certificate corruptions and one source-byte corruption reject in both normal and optimized Python.
- Deleting one owner33 scalar edge permits a three-dimensional return in the relaxed containment graph; the control checks all 31,741 remaining edges, the complete local prelude chain and an explicit invertible G. It is not a physical replacement circuit or a simultaneous completion of every native map.
- All six registered Python 3.12 checks pass. Committed-byte comparison, the official 14-file export/integrity check and isolated optimized Git-free replay pass without changing payloads. The optional full source-history preflight was unavailable in this shallow clone; stored-object provenance and exact bytes passed.

**Scientific review requested:** the new post-inverse source paths, the paired `G/G^-1` implication, and the exact scope of the deletion control. This closes the inverse-growth subroute left open by PR5096; it is not a new kappa, a global moment ceiling, supplier admission or a full multiplication theorem. Archival merging alone would not establish scientific acceptance of the statement.

Credit Cao Yifan/intqwq for the actual PR4610 word; Cinna Davis for PR5096's first-image theorem and certificate method and the supplier/controller lineage; Dugongue, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and retained source authors. Prepared for THU New Media Research Center (@thu-nmrc) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate research and adversarial-review contexts. No independent human or proof-kernel certification is claimed.
